description: Search Amazon for Valentine's / romantic gift ideas on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured for the default storefront, otherwise romantic-filtered search deep-link cards + catalogMatches. Prefer buyUrl / trackingTag in results. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers (amazon.com/dp links, English) or amazon.se for Sweden; without it, country, then Accept-Language en-US → amazon.com, else amazon.se. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

country.description: ISO country of the shopper, e.g. US or SE. Used when marketplace is omitted (US → amazon.com).

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en-US, en, sv. amazon.com always answers in English.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user: amazon.com (United States) or amazon.se (Sweden, default); ids like us/se also work. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers to get amazon.com/dp/ASIN links with English titles. If omitted, country is used, then Accept-Language (en-US → amazon.com), else amazon.se. A missing store never errors.

name: search_gifts
title: Search Valentine gifts
